class Jumbo_Packet;
    const int max_size = 9 * 1024; // global constant
    byte payload [];
    function new( int size );
        payload = new[ size > max_size ? max_size : size ];
    endfunction
endclass

class Big_Packet;
    const int size; // instance constant
    byte payload [];
    function new();
        size = $urandom % 4096; //one assignment in new -> ok
        payload = new[ size ];
    endfunction
endclass
